name: 7de Laan
description: 7de Laan is an extraordinary microcosm where good and bad, evil and wholesome characters find themselves forming part of a wholesome community where no matter what – everyone counts and everyone cares…

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Madel shows San Mari how one is actually supposed to dance. Robyn eavesdrops while Altus talks to George about his money. Xander confronts Vince about his statement. Is he convinced by Vinces’ explanation?

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Paula and Mandla butt heads over the dancing. Neville is worried about Vince who is worried about his future. Finally, the first round of the dance competition arrives - who comes out tops?

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Robyn is excited about the success of one of her business transactions. Jan Hendrik is not too happy with Dezi wanting to re-launch the boutique. Charmaine plays mommy with Diederik. Vince tries to be nonchalant about the murder but does he manage to deceive Vanessa?

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Dezi is upset about Madel’s interest in the business of the boutique. Neville orders Mandla not to write an article about Vince. Dezi and Altus’ mistrust of Robyn proves to have been correct. Charmaine and Neville get silly with the dancing. Could it be love blooming?

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Vince lies to save himself but does Xander believe him? San Mari takes time off work because of a crisis at home. Paula and Mandla just can’t seem to work together. Vanessa teases Charmaine about possibly having feelings for a certain attractive newspaper editor.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Paula makes a drastic and dramatic decision. Mandla gets a new dance partner. Vince is still continuing with his lies, but does Vanessa believe him? Hilda and Matrone are at each others’ throats. Dezi is hesitant about Theron and Terreblanche’s broker.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Jan Hendrik is not in favour of Dezi’s re-launching of the boutique. Kabelo hurts himself while dancing; can he still save the situation? Xander exposes Vince and warns him about the consequences of his actions.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Matrone is not happy with the way Heloise is giving points. Jan Hendrik and Dezi are fighting like cat and dog. Diederik gives money out left, right and centre. Robyn succeeds with a huge business transaction. Xander speaks to Kabelo about Vince.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Vince is still lying. Marko and San-Mari scheme on how to increase their chances of winning. Maria shows Oubaas and Hilda how to jive. Dezi volunteers to store new outfits in the boutiques’ store room. Is something brewing between Neville and Charmaine?

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Xander tries to talk some sense into Vince. Madel is very excited about Robyns’ coffee plant proposal. Matrone gets bribed with bowling shoes. Ryno is very worried about Emma. Celeste panics when Vince tells her he told Xander everything.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Matrone misuses her position as a judge. Dezi is running around like a headless chicken. Neville is in love and positive about life, are those wedding bells ringing? Tension runs high between Vince and Celeste.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Alyce finds out what Matrone is up to. Dance costumes arrive but they need to be ironed. The Hillsiders have the club on fire with their dancing and it seems there’s a smoldering in the boutique too. The finalists for the competition are announced.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: As the dancers come home from the competition they’re shocked by what they find in the boutique. Dezi and Jan Hendrik make an important announcement. Xander finds himself at a crossroads. Another disaster befalls Dezi and Jan Hendrik.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Xander thinks the truth should be told so he makes a huge decision. Madel hears about Dezi’s mistake and she’s furious. The young crowd confronts Matrone about the low points she’s giving them. Maria has a solution for Dezi. Celeste takes drastic steps while Vince struggles to cope.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Paula gets upset when she sees Altus chatting to another girl. The Terreblanche family is under a lot of stress with the situation at the boutique. Charmaine invites Neville over for dinner – could this be the night he’ll pop the question? Vince spills the beans.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Dezi goes over Jan Hendriks’ head with business pertaining to the boutique. Xander becomes more pessimistic about his future. Neville tries to make sense of Vince’s mess. Vanessa warns her mother against Neville.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Hilda’s giving out “dadelvingers” while Paula snoops for an in-depth article. Neville’s plans seem to clash with Charmaines. Are San – Mari and Marko dancing Vanessa and Xander out of the competition or will Mandla and Aggie show them a thing or two?

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: San-Mari negotiates with Marko about his half of the prize. Dezi is feeling even more hopeless about her situation. Emma’s future – a warm, happy moment. Madel and Dezi have a frank conversation. Celeste shocks Vince with her decision.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Emma makes plans without Ryno. Xander receives good news. Dezi gets an idea to save her situation – but will it work? Danny and San Mari speculate about Robyn’s secrecy. Neville and Charmaine still seem to be talking past each other.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Vanessa is worried about her mother. Altus, Danny and San – Mari begin to unravel Robyn’s coffee plant plans. Diederik forgets to give Charmaine an important message from Neville.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: San-Mari discovers skeletons in the closet of her past. Vanessa seems more excited than Charmaine is about their trip. Danny and Altus almost get caught in their search for more answers about Robyn, but they find an important piece of the puzzle.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Xander is worried about this brother and father. Dezi reveals her plan to save the boutique, with or without Jan Hendrik. The gambling bug has bitten Diederik. Robyn wraps Jan Hendrik around her pinky. San-Mari, Danny and Altus finally put two and two together.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Hilda goes full steam ahead with her plans for the Deli party. Dezi is frustrated with Jan Hendriks’ lack of interest in the boutique. Robyn is suspicious about Danny and Altus’ secrecy. San-Mari walks right into the lions den.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Robyn invites Danny and Altus over for dinner. Neville is shocked when he hears that Vanessa and Charmaine have already left. Marko gives Diederik a friendly warning about the dangers of gambling. Altus hears that San-Mari has the flu but something doesn’t look right.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Altus struggles to get hold of the Terreblanches. Dezi realizes what the consequences of Robyn’s actions mean for Jan Hendrik and Madel - and what about Kyriakis De Lange? Marko tries his best to comfort San-Mari. Paula and Altus still secretly long for each other.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Dezi gets hold of Jan Hendrik - it seems there’s big trouble. Xander helps Danny and Altus with the legal implications for Kyriakis De Lange. Vanessa calls with shocking news about Charmaine. Paula gets the idea that Neville is leaving the paper in her hands.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Jan Hendrik feels powerless about his situation. Everyone is shocked about Charmaines’ accident. Neville decides it’s now or never. Aggie sees trouble when Paula thinks she’s boss. Altus is determined to make things work for him and Danny.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Charmaine isn’t sure how to handle Neville. Diederik sinks deeper into gambling. Xander plants a business seed in Altus’ head. The Hillside Times team is surprised when Neville rocks up and cancels Washington

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Matrone is very busy writing. Altus and Danny are ready for big things with Kyriakis De Lange. Robyn disappears into thin air. San-Mari shares a tender moment with Marko. Dezi gets upset with Tessa who comes back from the airport empty handed.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Jan Hendrik and Dezi have a horrible fight. Paula is finished with Altus, for good. San-Mari is unsure of Marko’s feelings for her. Ryno confronts Jan Hendrik about his relationship with Dezi. Vanessa is surprised when she starts developing feelings for someone.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Maria is suspicious of Brett. Xander wonders what’s going on with an obviously absent-minded Vanessa. Matrone is preparing herself for a major writing expedition. San-Mari and Marko argue. Diederik isn’t doing too well with the poker but will his luck change?

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Everyone’s excited about Felicity’s return. Mandla is frustrated with Matrone who’s using his computer. The Sheriff comes to repossess Robyn’s assets. Vanessa’s still fighting her emotions.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Aggie almost gets caught in the Notnagel offices. Karien and Danny help Altus to set up a temporary “cardboard” office. A desperate Marko finds a solution for his financial crisis. Jan Hendrik prepares himself for the banks assessment.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Diederik has plans to win big money. Aggie is struggling to keep Mandla and Paula in check. Altus is full of hope with his new venture. Mandla plants a seed with Matrone about asking Ryno for help. Oubaas gets unexpected guests.

videos.overview: Charmaine picks up that something is wrong with Diederik. And Alyce, on the other hand is too in love to notice that something’s going on with Vanessa too. Ryno gets himself out of a meal with Matrone. Brett’s comments about Diederik get Marko thinking.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Diederik is sweating blood about Theron and Terreblanche’s books. Maria scolds Gert and Cheryl. Tessa and Danny wonder what’s going on with Aggie. Jan Hendrik notices that Theron and Terreblanches books are not balancing.

videos.overview: Karien tells Altus about a promising contract. Marko is completely shocked when Jan Hendrik confronts him about the money that has disappeared – could this be Marko’s end? Vanessa is surprised by her dance partners’ feelings for her.

videos.title: Episode 58

videos.overview: Emma admits that she is ready to have someone special in her life. Matrone believes she has finally found out what Hilda's secret ingredient is. Xanders' working conditions seem to be getting more and more complicated by the day.

videos.title: Episode 183
videos.overview: Vanessa tries to calm a worried Xander. Hilda comes up with a plan to put Matrone in her place. Alyce is desperately searching for a new flatmate.

videos.title: Episode 184
videos.overview: Vanessa gets shocking news from Xander. A concerned Charmaine sees through Errol and starts to really worry about Errol's relationship with Jocelyn. Kabelo gathers together the courage to apologise to Annelie.

videos.title: Episode 185
videos.overview: Paula is not impressed with their new flatmate. Ryno gets an idea about how to get Isabelle inspired again. Altus discovers what has been going on behind his back.

videos.title: Episode 186
videos.overview: Lukas takes control in his new home. Charmaine hears that Jocelyn plans to stay in Hillside. Vanessa and Xander argue about his sudden plans for a vacation.

videos.title: Episode 187
videos.overview: Paula is very upset because she is now expected to clean the flat. Jan-Hendrik is uncertain about the future of the Art gallery. Oubaas finds out what Hilda has been doing behind his back with the boerewors competition.

videos.title: Episode 188
videos.overview: Jan-Hendrik decides it will be better for him to close the gallery so that he can forget about Helena all together. Diederik and Paula have a little argument. Alyce is determined to make Mandla jealous. Felicity suggests that Charmaine contact the social worker again.

videos.title: Episode 189
videos.overview: Paula and Danny see Marko and Jan giggling together. Errol is confused when he has to decide who to take with to a school function. Xander is determined to prove his innocence.

videos.title: Episode 190
videos.overview: Excitement is in the air with the final of the boerewors competition. Hilda tries everything in her power to wrap Oubaas around her pinkie so that he will agree to going to the boerewors competition. Alyce arrives at the finals...with another guy.

videos.title: Episode 191
videos.overview: A lot of people seem to be unhappy with the results of the competition. Vanessa is upset by the threats John is making. The social worker is surprised when she finds out about Errol's mother.

videos.title: Episode 192
videos.overview: Paula and Alyce are not at all happy about having to clean the flat. The social worker asks Errol about his mother. Kabelo makes another appointment to see the therapist.

videos.title: Episode 193
videos.overview: Ryno gets a brilliant idea on how to get Isabelle inspired again……Vanessa and Emma are very worried about Charmaines' emotional state. Hilda refuses point blank to make peace with Maria.

videos.title: Episode 194
videos.overview: Paula and Alyce manage very easily to wrap Lukas around their pinkies. A stressed Vanessa and Charmaine have an argument. Aggie tries to give Jocelyn some perspective about Errol and Charmaine.

videos.title: Episode 195
videos.overview: The young crowd is excited about "Die Kaalkop-waarheid" coming to perform in the club. Charmaine decides to invite Jocelyn over for dinner. Oubaas and Hilda struggle without Maria.

videos.title: Episode 196
videos.overview: Alyce and Paula convince Lukas again to prepare a 5 star meal for them. Emma feels sorry for a depressed Oubaas. Xander and Mandla look everywhere for answers about Xanders' unprecedented dismissal.

videos.title: Episode 197
videos.overview: Ryno has finally finished the last chapter of his book. Everyone is up in arms about Jan-Hendrik's plans with the shops. A determined Xander makes an appointment with Notnagel. The young crowd is relieved that Kabelo is back to his old self again.

videos.title: Episode 198
videos.overview: Charmaine doesn't know who to turn to regarding her situation with Errol. Matrone scolds Isabelle about her jewellery which is still not finished yet. Paula is up to her usual tricks again.

videos.title: Episode 199
videos.overview: Paula puts her plan into action…. Felicity tries to motivate an upset Isabelle. Charmaine and Errol have a great time together. Everyone is talking about Jan-Hendrik who has decided to still continue with his plans for the shops.

videos.title: Episode 200
videos.overview: Jocelyn makes plans with Errol for the whole weekend. Isabelle can finally focus more on her designs now and slowly but surely get back on track. The therapist suggests hypnosis to Kabelo.

videos.title: Episode 201
videos.overview: Diederik is confused and irritated about his situation with San-Mari. Charmaine is angry when Errol comes home late after being with Jocelyn, and it looks like he had a great time too…..Hilda is very upset when she hears what Jan-Hendriks' plans are. Ryno is relieved to see Isabelle designing again.

videos.title: Episode 202
videos.overview: Charmaine realises Errol is more reserved than usual. Jocelyn and Donovan flirt heavily with each other. Diederik and San-Mari are both too stubborn to make peace with one another. Alyce hears that Lukas wants to move out of the flat.

videos.title: Episode 203
videos.overview: Jocelyn tells Aggie that she wants to make an appointment to see the social worker. Xander has an idea on how to stop Jan-Hendriks plans. Matrone is very impressed with Isabelle's designs. Jocelyn arrives at Charmaine's house to see Errol and also tell Charmaine some very important news.

videos.title: Episode 204
videos.overview: Charmaine is surprised by Jocelyn's news. Isabelle tells Ryno that she's already seen the end of his book in a movie. San-Mari and Diederik make an important decision about their relationship. Donovan sees Jocelyn crying and invites her out for dinner to cheer her up.

videos.title: Episode 205
videos.overview: Charmaine is urgently looking for the social worker. Donovan invites Jocelyn out to go to the club. Everyone has loads of fun and is excited about Freshly Ground performing in the club. San-Mari and Diederik seem to be constantly out to make each other jealous.

videos.title: Episode 206
videos.overview: Charmaine assures Errol that he will also have a say in issues concerning him. The therapist hypnotizes Kabelo again. The social worker tries to put Charmaine at ease. Donovan sweeps Jocelyn off her feet. Paula finally receives a call back from a publisher about her plans.

videos.title: Episode 207
videos.overview: San-Mari and Lukas have a serious talk with Jan-Hendrik. Jocelyn is excited at the prospect of having Errol with her full time. Paula is discouraged when she returns from her meeting with the publisher. Donovan arrives at Jocelyn's place of work with a gift for her. A young girl arrives at Ryno and Isabelle's house.

videos.title: Episode 208
videos.overview: Jocelyn is determined to be a good mother. Isabelle wants to get Terry enrolled in school as soon as possible but Terry has other plans. Matrone is relieved to see that Kabelo is his old self again. Charmaine tells Errol that he can go and live with his mother if he wants to.

videos.title: Episode 209
videos.overview: Ryno and Isabelle are worried about Terry. Vanessa is jealous about how Charmaine feels about Errol. Jocelyn and Donovan dance and drink wine in her flat. Errol tells Charmaine that he has now decided to go and live with Jocelyn.

videos.title: Episode 210
videos.overview: Errol runs into Jocelyn in the Deli and he tells her that he's decided to move in with her. Terry asks San-Mari where people in Hillside go to have fun. Tonight is Matrone's big night with the Vonkelvrou competition and the girls help her to get ready. Charmaine helps Errol pack his clothes.

videos.title: Episode 211
videos.overview: Ryno's excited about the new ending of his book. Altus gives Paula the number of another publisher. Jan-Hendrik excitedly shows Emma his plans for the new shops. The girls try to come up with a plan to get San-Mari and Diederik back together again.

videos.title: Episode 212
videos.overview: The petition against Jan-Hendrik is going ahead; full steam. Isabelle tells Terry that Hillside High is getting a new Maths teacher who's going to help her. Terry flirts with Lukas in O'Malley's. Donovan isn't happy when he finds out that Errol is now living with Jocelyn.

videos.title: Episode 213
videos.overview: Errol's confused about the previous night's incident with Donovan. Jocelyn tries to put Donovan at ease. Marko predicts the ending of Ryno's book. Charmaine and Vanessa have a huge argument. The young crowd's efforts to get Diederik and San-Mari to reconcile are a huge flop.

videos.title: Episode 214
videos.overview: San-Mari's uncle phones and makes an appointment to meet with her. Diederik and San-Mari are both upset with their friends for meddling in their business. Maria is depressed because the contractor for her guesthouse has run away with her money. Lukas and Terry are out at the club and she is not honest with him about who she really is.

videos.title: Episode 215
videos.overview: sabelle asks Terry about the new Maths teacher. Jocelyn tells Aggie about her and Donovan's reconciliation the night before. San-Mari tells Jan-Hendrik about the boycott. Jocelyn tries to explain to Errol where she was last night. A huge protest march is being planned in Hillside.

videos.title: Episode 216
videos.overview: Errol tells Charmaine very excitedly about his mothers' boyfriend and how much fun the three of them have. Terry slips out of the house again when Ryno and Isabelle go out for dinner. Errol is very disappointed when he realises that Jocelyn and Donovan's plans don't include him. Ryno tells Isabelle that he has writers block

videos.title: Episode 217
videos.overview: Charmaine tells Xander that she's worried about Errol, but it sounds as if they're having fun. Mandla tells Lukas about Alyce and Paula's scam. Lukas is furious and Mandla decides to expose them. Donovan moves in with Jocelyn and he takes her out to dinner. Errol realises that he's not going with them. Isabelle discovers that Terry's not in her bed.

videos.title: Episode 218
videos.overview: It's late at night and Ryno and Isabelle are waiting for Terry. Everybody's in the Deli busy planning the protest march against Jan-Hendrik and Hilda volunteers to toyi toyi in the front. Paula and Alyce are surprised when the people who pitch up for dinner are not their friends.

videos.title: Episode 219
videos.overview: Paula and Alyce reads in the Hillside Times that the money they made will be donated to charity. Jocelyn asks Errol to cover for her at work. Alyce's furious when she realises that Mandla's the reason for her humiliation. The protest march is chaotic and Hilda has an attack.

videos.title: Episode 220
videos.overview: Hilda's taken to hospital in an ambulance and Charmaine disperses the crowd. Jan-Hendrik decides to close T&T for the rest of the day. Terry tells San-Mari about her date with Diederik. Donovan and Jocelyn start kissing and Donovan gives Errol R50 and tells him to leave. Errol tries to explain that he has homework to do but to no avail.

videos.title: Episode 221
videos.overview: Errol reminds Jocelyn about an event at school. Jan-Hendrik makes peace with San-Mari and Lukas and tells them that he's going away for a few weeks. Jocelyn forgets about Errol's school event. Isabelle and Ryno are astonished when Terry comes home drunk.

videos.title: Episode 222
videos.overview: Ryno gives Terry a piece of his mind the morning after her drunkedness. Marko sees Jocelyn in JJ's and he realises there might be problems. Alyce finds a new flat mate for her and Paula. Donovan apologizes to Jocelyn and they make up, but Errol doesn't think it's such a good thing for them to be back together.

videos.title: Episode 223
videos.overview: Alyce is furious with Paula when she realises what Paula used as inspiration for her Goue Gedagtes. Paula reads her Goue Gedagtes to Altus and is relieved when he likes it. Emma tells the guys who Terry really is. Errol doesn't know how to handle the situation with Jocelyn and Donovan. Terry realises her game is up.

videos.title: Episode 224
videos.overview: All the youngsters decide to go and see Straatligkinders in the club. San-Mari decides to rather watch dvd's with her uncle, Cas. Everybody is staring at Terry drinking herself into a stupor in the club. She storms out when Altus volunteers to take her home. San-Mari wakes up just as Cas gets the pizza's, and he tells her what happened at the end of the movie.

videos.title: Episode 225
videos.overview: Felicity asks Aggie how Jocelyn's doing. She tells Felicity that the little family is happier than ever. Isabelle tries to talk to Terry. Paula tries to find inspiration for the illustrations for her calendar. Charmaine sees Jocelyn in the boutique and tells her to spend more time with Errol. Ryno gets a call from his publisher that upsets him. Jocelyn wants to stay with Errol but Donovan won't let him spoil their fun.

videos.title: Episode 226
videos.overview: Donovan tries to convince Errol that everything is fine with him and Jocelyn. Emma and Felicity tell Isabelle about Terry's antics. Charmaine's frustrated when the social worker doesn't want to believe her that something is wrong with Errol. Marko asks San-Mari to accompany him to a fancy dinner. The social worker decides to visit Errol.

videos.title: Episode 227
videos.overview: Ryno's stressed about his meeting with Herman and tells Isabelle about his frustration with Terry. Marko tells the guys about the fun he had with San-Mari and Diederik doesn't look impressed. Errol talks to Emma about his mother. Paula gets a brilliant idea for her Goue Gedagtes calendar. Terry tells Ryno and Isabelle something that shocks them.

videos.title: Episode 228
videos.overview: Ryno and Isabelle can't believe what Terry's telling them. Charmaine asks Errol about his exams and invite him to dinner. Ryno and Isabelle don't know what to do, and Ryno thinks that Terry is lying. Errol experiences Donovan's temper first hand.

videos.title: Episode 229
videos.overview: Isabelle tries to convince Terry to go to the police and Ryno organizes for the lawyer to meet them at the police station. San-Mari and Cas are discussing their camping trip when a detective asks Cas to come with him to the police station. Donovan is looking for Jocelyn in JJ's and gets angry when she is not there. San-Mari is very upset when with everybody's accusations of Cas.

videos.title: Episode 230
videos.overview: Jocelyn's excited about her weekend away with Donovan. Donovan gives Errol R50 to entertain himself for the weekend. Isabelle sees Cas and confronts him. Cas explains to San-Mari that he has an alibi. Ryno's afraid that Terry might have made the whole thing up, and Isabelle's outraged that he can even think that.

videos.title: Episode 231
videos.overview: Terry's parents finally phone and Isabelle finds it difficult to tell them what happened to Terry. Jocelyn is back from her weekend with Donovan. Vanessa tells Charmaine that Errol was alone the whole weekend. The detective questions San-Mari about the night she and Cas were watching dvd's.

videos.title: Episode 232
videos.overview: Terry is aware of everybody staring at her in the bookshop. San-Mari decides to confront Terry about her allegations. Isabelle hears that Terry was flirting with all the men in Hillside and that she was very drunk the night of the rape. Cas tells San-Mari about Terry's threats.

videos.title: Episode 233
videos.overview: Isabelle tells Ryno that she thinks Terry might be lying. Aggie asks Errol why Jocelyn quit her job at JJ's. The detective asks Terry some more questions but it doesn't go well. Errol tries to study but Jocelyn keeps interrupting him for advice. Ryno and Isabelle are discussing the situation with Terry, and she hears something that she doesn't like.

videos.title: Episode 234
videos.overview: Isabelle apologizes to Terry about the previous night. Terry asks Diederik to meet her at a coffee shop. He goes but is afraid to become involved. Paula tries to convince Felicity to design twelve outfits that she can model for her Goue Gedagtes calendar. Terry asks Isabelle to give her mother a message. She goes up stairs and opens her shopping.

videos.title: Episode 235
videos.overview: Isabelle is knocking at Terry's door but she doesn't want to open, she doesn't even answer. Ryno and Isabelle make a shock discovery. Donovan sees Jocelyn speaking with another man, and a fight breaks out. Paula finds a great photographer right under her nose. Jocelyn tells Errol about the fight Donovan was involved in, but she defends him. Terry's parents arrive at Ryno and Isabelle's house.

videos.title: Episode 236
videos.overview: Terry's parents are still in shock over what happened. Jocelyn realises that Donovan never came home. Paula tells Diederik that he is the new photographer for her calendar but he has no idea what she is talking about. Isabelle gives Terry's mother the note she found in Terry's room.

videos.title: Episode 237
videos.overview: Jocelyn is determined to find a new job. Isabelle and Ryno is busy organizing Terry's funeral. Donovan pitches up at Jocelyn's flat to pick up his clothes and tells her he is leaving. She begs him to stay and clings to him.

videos.title: Episode 238
videos.overview: Hilda is planning a big do to celebrate her new found health but later reveals that is to impress Altus. Emma tells San-Mari something that might make her unsure of Cas's innocence. San-Mari has good news for Cas. Donovan phones Jocelyn from Ermelo.

videos.title: Episode 239
videos.overview: Jocelyn wants to make things right with Donovan and wants to speak to him eye to eye. Charmaine and Errol have a huge fight. Nicolette apologizes to Isabelle about her behavior at the funeral. Errol waits for Jocelyn at home and she finally pitches up with arms full of shopping.

videos.title: Episode 240
videos.overview: Vince and Vanessa are taken aback when Marko tells them that the Deli shouldn't even try competing for the big contract Bruynwaves is handling. But Vanessa has a plan that might save the day. Charmaine volunteers to have Hilda's big dinner in Oppiekoffie and the other guests are planning to dress according to a theme.

videos.title: Episode 241
videos.overview: Aggie phones looking for Jocelyn but Errol tells her she went for a job interview. Ryno is frustrated that nobody wants to publish his book. Altus gives Hilda good news San-Mari hears a comment about the movie she watched with Cas the night of the rape.

videos.title: Episode 242
videos.overview: Alyce and Vanessa is curious about San-Mari's date with Marko. Aggie pitches up at Jocelyn's flat and Errol has to lie again about where she is. San-Mari questions Cas about the movie, but he has a valid excuse. Errol tells Emma that he and Jocelyn will be going to Durban for the holidays. San-Mari sees Cas looking at schoolgirls.

videos.title: Episode 243
videos.overview: San-Mari is surprised when she hears that Mario's Pizza doesn't deliver. Errol asks Jan-Hendrik for extra work when he realises that there is no more food left in the flat. San-Mari phones her aunt Monika to find out why she and Cas got divorced

videos.title: Episode 244
videos.overview: Cas realises that San-Mari is avoiding him. Paula realises that time is running out for taking the pictures for her Goue Gedagtes Calendar. Cas gets a phone call from his ex wife. Cas waits for San-Mari in her flat.

videos.title: Episode 245
videos.overview: There is an incident in the girls flat but luckily Ryno and Isabelle pitches up just in time. Alyce sees Mandla with the social worker and tries to listen to their conversation in Oppiekoffie. Diederik hears San-Mari and Marko talking in the flat and he gets jealous.

videos.title: Episode 246
videos.overview: It is the day of Paula's photo session for her calendar and she is driving Aggie up the wall. The publisher of the calendar tells Paula that he doesn't want her on more than one of the pictures, and recommends more couples. Alyce bumps into Tshepiso in Oppiekoffie and makes her feelings known.

videos.title: Episode 247
videos.overview: Diederik shows the girls the pictures but they are less than happy. Cas wants to see San-Mari. Vince and Xander talk about the plans for Christmas and they hope that Charmaine and Errol makes peace before Christmas. San-Mari decides to go and see Cas.

videos.title: Episode 248
videos.overview: Oubaas invites all the lost souls of Hillside for dinner. Jocelyn phones to tell Errol that she and Donovan is on their way to spend Christmas with him. Errol tells Aggie that his mother is coming back. Isabelle visits Helena in prison. Errol waits with great excitement for Jocelyn.

videos.title: Episode 249
videos.overview: Paula gives out the expensive presents she bought for everybody. Errol gets bad news. Charmaine decides to take Errol his present. Jan-Hendrik visits Helena in prison. Tiffany visits Dawid in hospital.

videos.title: Episode 250
videos.overview: Vanessa confronts Errol. Everybody suffers from a food hangover but still accepts when Hilda invites them for left overs. Charmaine invites Errol back home and Diederik and Marko are surprised when Charmaine pitches up at home with Errol and his belongings

videos.title: Episode 251
videos.overview: Marko tells San-Mari exactly how he feels about her. The Witbank Flooze pitches up and tells Paula that she willl be staying with her in the flat for a few days. Charmaine hears how Errol lies to Aggie about why he is living with Charmaine again. Tiffany sees Dawid's hand move.

videos.title: Episode 252
videos.overview: San-Mari meets the Flooze from Witbank, and the Flooze invites them for a drink in O'Malley's. Ryno's uncle Tim phones and Ryno insists that he stays with them while he is in Johannesburg. Tiffany tries to convince the doctor that Dawid moved. Charmaine and Errol pack up Jocelyn's flat. Oubaas wants to know from the Flooze where Neef Gert is.

videos.title: Episode 253
videos.overview: Alyce gets a brilliant idea to kick off the new year. She plans a party and dance competition in the club. Everybody is excited except the Flooze. Oubaas is flattered when Alyce asks him to make a speech on 2008. Alyce is jealous when she sees who Mandla is dancing with in the competition. At twelve San-Mari gets a kiss and Mandla twirls Tshepiso.

videos.title: Episode 254
videos.overview: The Flooze announces that she is finished with men like Neef Gert and wants to chase a certain metroman of Hillside. Ryno is ready to fetch his uncle, Tim, from the airport. The doctor has good news for Tiffany. The Flooze asks Paula to help her with a new appearance.

videos.title: Episode 255
videos.overview: Tiffany gets a fright when she sees Dawid asleep in his bed. Ryno introduces Tim to the people of Hillside. Tim is approached by a British man with a proposition. Paula helps the Flooze to find new outfits in the boutique. Jan-Hendrik visits Helena in prison and declares his love to her.

videos.title: Episode 256
videos.overview: Before sunrise Tim is pacing up and down in the house. Isabelle finds his behavior odd. The Flooze is driving San-Mari and Paula up the wall. Alyce sees Mandla and Tshepiso in O'Malleys and does a good job of hiding her jealousy. Isabelle walks in on a phone conversation Tim is having.

videos.title: Episode 257
videos.overview: Tim has to go to Sao Paolo to solve a crisis. Diederik warns Marko not to hurt San-Mari and assures him that he doesn't have feelings for her. Dawid asks Tiffany if she is the one who shot him. She is upset by his question and tells him it was Helena. He remembers what happened the night in the gallery.

videos.title: Episode 258
videos.overview: Paula tells the Flooze that she will have to sell her motorcycle to buy all the new clothes she will need. One of the waiters in Oppiekoffie quits their job. The news spreads like wild fire, San-Mari is upset and Marko is surprised. Tiffany is planning a holiday for her and Dawid, but he has other plans. A big make over for the Flooze is under way in the girls flat.

videos.title: Episode 259
videos.overview: Jan-Hendrik shows everybody the brochure of the new sports car he has ordered. Paula decides it's a good time to test drive the makeover they gave the Flooze and they make plans to go to the club. Paula is determined to give her calendar prime position in the bookshop, much to Matrone's dismay. Tim unexpectedly arrives back from Sao Paulo.

videos.title: Episode 260
videos.overview: Alyce tells Paula that she organized a blind date for the Flooze but Paula is not so certain that she is ready. Annelie, Xander, Danny and Vanessa start organizing a farewell party for Diederik. Tiffany is over the moon when she sees Dawid walking. Alyce sabotages Mandla's date with Tshepiso. The Flooze comes back from her date all covered in oil and her dress torn.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Emma asks Annelie how her date with Jan-Hendrik went. Jan-Hendrik invites himself to the boys farewell for Diederik. Neef Gert pitches up at Oubaas and Hilda's flat and he looks terrible. Isabelle snoops around in Tim's room and find something that she didn't expect.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Paula tells the girls that she organized an exclusive interview with Ryk Neethling for the following day. Maria tells Neef Gert that the Flooze is in Hillside. Isabelle tells Felicity about discovery and Felicity tells her not to say a word until Ryno gets back. decides to phone the Police.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Dawid and Tiffany arrive in Oppiekoffie and the news that Dawid is back in Hillside spreads like a wildfire. Paula is waiting for Ryk, but decides to leave when he is late. Ryk finally pitches up, but another girl decides that he is just the man for her. Jan-Hendrik asks Emma to go out to dinner with him. Tim tells Ryno why he had to smuggle the drugs.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Isabelle feels guilty that she put Ryno's aunt in danger. San-Mari and Alyce can't wait to hear how the Flooze's date with Ryk Neethling went. Tiffany sees people talking about her and Dawid and she begs him to come home with her. Neef Gert decides to get back into shape to win back the Flooze. Diederik disappears from his own party to say good bye to San-Mari.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Oppiekoffie is buzzing about the Hillside Times front page about the man caught with drugs. Alyce plans a karaoke night. Paula thinks it's a horrible idea but the Flooze is very keen to belt out 'n few notes. San-Mari can't find the words to tell Marko what is really going on. There is a serious car accident.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Diederik insists that San-Mari tell Marko the truth about their relationship, but she wants to wait until the big Mandaat function is over. Neef Gert takes some homemade cupcakes for the Flooze. Maria invited too many people on the tour. Jan-Hendrik invites Emma to a business dinner.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Marko is very upset with what he is seeing, and San-Mari tries to explain. But Marko is not interested and San-Mari asks him to leave after a fight almost breaks out between him and Diederik. Alyce and Paula are helping the Flooze get ready for her date with Neef Gert. There is a problem at the Hillside Times and it seems that all the computers are infected with a virus.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: There is huge excitement in Oppiekoffie about the karaoke night in the club. Charmaine finds out what happened between Marko and Diederik. The Flooze is very unimpressed by her date with Neef Gert. Isabelle sees Annelie and Dawid kissing. There is chaos at the Hillside Time, and the IT specialist sees something that is not intended for his eyes.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Hilda forces Maria to uninvite Matrone to the Soweto tour. Everybody is gearing up for the karaoke night, even Hilda and Oubaas plans to sing. Isabelle sees Dawid and Tiffany kissing. The karaoke is a huge success and the Flooze grabs the microphone for her turn. Halfway through her song she sees Neeg Gert flirting with another woman and she has trouble controlling herself.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Isabelle tells Ryno how Dawid is upsetting her by his behavior, and Ryno tells her not to get involved. Neef Gert picks up the Flooze for a date, and it's very clear that they are not trying to be metro anymore. Isabelle tries to tell Tiffany that Dawid is double crossing her, but she doesn't want to listen to anything Isabelle has to say.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Dawid dumps Annelie, and her heart is broken. The Hillside Times team find out that money is missing from the newspapers account, and that it was transferred from the internet account with Aggie's password. Maria tells Matrone a lie so she won't come with on the Soweto tour. Isabelle overhears how Annelie tells Charmaine that Dawid dumped her. Emma and Jan-Hendrik go to a concert in the park and later he shocks her with a question.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: The Hillside Times team is trying to figure out who could have stolen the money. Aggie remembers something that might help them. Jan-Hendrik sends Emma flowers and Alyce is very excited to hear that the two of them are dating. The Qwa Qwa Express has their first tour to Soweto.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Emma tells San-Mari that she and Jan-Hendrik started dating. Alyce tries to find out from Emma if she is sure that Jan-Hendrik feels the same way about her, because she is obviously in love. Vince is in financial trouble due to the Soweto tour being a disaster. Dawid invites Isabelle for drinks and she accepts. Errol hears of the trouble the Hillside Times is in, but is very excited to hear that Neville is on his way back

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Felicity hears Isabelle lying to Ryno. Oubaas buys a Kudu from Swannie and starts handing out the meat when Hilda refuses to have the whole carcass in het freezer. Isabelle and Linda are planning a party. Neville is back from the bank with bad news. Felicity confronts Isabelle about her and Dawid, and Isabelle tells her about her plans for him.
